texts.title_original: Pope, Essay on Man Epistle II
texts.title_ja: ポープ『人間論』第2書
ポープ『批評論』

texts.title_original: Swift, Description of a City Shower
texts.title_ja: スウィフト「都の驟雨の描写」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Careful observers may foretell the hour
(By sure prognostics) when to dread a shower

texts.title_original: Johnson, The Vanity of Human Wishes
texts.title_ja: ジョンソン「人間の願望の虚しさ」
コリンズ「夕べに寄す」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
If aught of oaten stop, or pastoral song,
May hope, chaste Eve, to soothe thy modest ear

texts.title_ja: スマート『ジュビレイト・アグノ』
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
For I will consider my Cat Jeoffry.
For he is the servant of the Living God duly and daily serving him

texts.title_ja: バーンズ「タム・オシャンター」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
When chapman billies leave the street,
And drouthy neibors neibors meet

texts.title_ja: バーンズ「オールド・ラング・サイン」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Should auld acquaintance be forgot,
And never brought to mind?
Should auld acquaintance be forgot,
And auld lang syne!

texts.title_ja: ブレイク「ジェルサレム」（And did those feet）
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
And did those feet in ancient time
Walk upon England's mountains green:
And was the holy Lamb of God,
On England's pleasant pastures seen!

texts.title_ja: ブレイク「煙突掃除人」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
When my mother died I was very young,
And my father sold me while yet my tongue
Could scarcely cry weep weep weep weep

texts.title_original: Blake, The Marriage of Heaven and Hell
texts.title_ja: ブレイク『天国と地獄の結婚』格言
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
The road of excess leads to the palace of wisdom.
Proverbs of Hell.
In seed time learn, in harvest teach, in winter enjoy.

texts.title_ja: ワーズワース「孤独な刈り女」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Behold her, single in the field,
Yon solitary Highland Lass!
Reaping and singing by herself;
Stop here, or gently pass!

texts.title_ja: ワーズワース「不滅の暗示」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
There was a time when meadow, grove, and stream,
The earth, and every common sight,
To me did seem
Apparelled in celestial light

texts.title_original: Wordsworth, She Dwelt Among the Untrodden Ways
texts.title_ja: ワーズワース「人跡未踏の道に住みし」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
She dwelt among the untrodden ways
Beside the springs of Dove,
A Maid whom there were none to praise
And very few to love

texts.title_ja: コールリッジ「失意のオード」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Well! If the Bard was weather-wise, who made
The grand old ballad of Sir Patrick Spence,
This night, so tranquil now

texts.title_ja: コールリッジ「真夜中の霜」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
The Frost performs its secret ministry,
Unhelped by any wind. The owlet's cry
Came loud—and hark, again! loud as before

texts.title_ja: バイロン『海賊』
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
O'er the glad waters of the dark blue sea,
Our thoughts as boundless, and our souls as free

texts.title_ja: バイロン『チャイルド・ハロルドの巡礼』
シェリー『アドネース』（キーツ哀悼詩）
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
I weep for Adonais—he is dead!
O, weep for Adonais! though our tears
Thaw not the frost which binds so dear a head!

texts.title_ja: シェリー「夜に寄す」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Swiftly walk o'er the western wave,
Spirit of Night!
Out of the misty eastern cave,
Where, all the long and lone daylight

texts.title_ja: キーツ『エンディミオン』第1巻冒頭
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
A thing of beauty is a joy for ever:
Its loveliness increases; it will never
Pass into nothingness; but still will keep
A bower quiet for us

texts.title_ja: キーツ「プシュケに寄す頌歌」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
O Goddess! hear these tuneless numbers, wrung
By sweet enforcement and remembrance dear

texts.title_ja: キーツ「秋に寄す」
クレア「我あり」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
I am—yet what I am none cares or knows;
My friends forsake me like a memory lost:
I am the self-consumer of my woes—
They rise and vanish in oblivious host

texts.title_original: Hood, The Song of the Shirt
texts.title_ja: フッド「シャツの歌」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
With fingers weary and worn,
With eyelids heavy and red,
A woman sat, in unwomanly rags,
Plying her needle and thread

texts.title_original: Tennyson, Charge of the Light Brigade
texts.title_ja: テニスン「軽騎兵旅団の突撃」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Half a league, half a league,
Half a league onward,
All in the valley of Death
Rode the six hundred

texts.title_ja: テニスン「砕けよ、砕けよ、砕けよ」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Break, break, break,
On thy cold gray stones, O Sea!
And I would that my tongue could utter
The thoughts that arise in me

texts.title_ja: テニスン「シャロットの貴婦人」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
On either side the river lie
Long fields of barley and of rye,
That clothe the wold and meet the sky;
And thro' the field the road runs by

texts.title_ja: ブラウニング『ピッパが通る』
クリスティナ・ロセッティ「Remember」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Remember me when I am gone away,
Gone far away into the silent land;
When you can no more hold me by the hand,
Nor I half turn to go yet turning stay.

texts.title_ja: クリスティナ・ロセッティ「Birthday」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
My heart is like a singing bird
Whose nest is in a watered shoot;
My heart is like an apple-tree
Whose boughs are bent with thickset fruit

texts.title_ja: クリスティナ・ロセッティ『ゴブリン・マーケット』
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Morning and evening
Maids heard the goblins cry:
'Come buy our orchard fruits,
Come buy, come buy:'

texts.title_ja: スウィンバーン「捨てられた庭」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
In a coign of the cliff between lowland and highland,
At the sea-down's edge between windward and lee

texts.title_ja: モリス『地上楽園』序
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Of Heaven or Hell I have no power to sing,
I cannot ease the burden of your fears

texts.title_ja: ヘンリー「インヴィクタス」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Out of the night that covers me,
Black as the pit from pole to pole,
I thank whatever gods may be
For my unconquerable soul.

texts.title_ja: キプリング「もしも」
texts.era_period: 後期ヴィクトリア・エドワーディアン
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
If you can keep your head when all about you
Are losing theirs and blaming it on you,
If you can trust yourself when all men doubt you,
But make allowance for their doubting too

texts.title_ja: ハーディ「声」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Woman much missed, how you call to me, call to me,
Saying that now you are not as you were
When you had changed from the one who was all to me

texts.title_ja: ハーディ「闇のツグミ」全文
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
At once a voice arose among
The bleak twigs overhead
In a full-hearted evensong
Of joy illimited

texts.title_ja: ホプキンス「チョウゲンボウ」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
I caught this morning morning's minion, king-
dom of daylight's dauphin, dapple-dawn-drawn Falcon, in his riding
Of the rolling level underneath him steady air

texts.title_ja: イェイツ「1916年復活祭」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
I have met them at close of day
Coming with vivid faces
From counter or desk among grey
Eighteenth-century houses

texts.title_ja: イェイツ「レダと白鳥」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
A sudden blow: the great wings beating still
Above the staggering girl, her thighs caressed
By the dark webs, her nape caught in his bill,
He holds her helpless breast upon his breast.

texts.title_ja: イェイツ「学童たちの中で」
オーウェン「祖国に死す」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Bent double, like old beggars under sacks,
Knock-kneed, coughing like hags, we cursed through sludge,
Till on the haunting flares we turned our backs,
And towards our distant rest began to trudge.

texts.title_ja: オーウェン「滅びゆく若者への賛歌」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
What passing-bells for these who die as cattle?
Only the monstrous anger of the guns.
Only the stuttering rifles' rapid rattle
Can patter out their hasty orisons.

texts.title_ja: ブルック「兵士」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
If I should die, think only this of me:
That there's some corner of a foreign field
That is for ever England.

texts.title_ja: サスーン「女たちの栄光」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
You love us when we're heroes, home on leave,
Or wounded in a mentionable place

texts.title_ja: エドワード・トマス「アドレストロップ」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Yes. I remember Adlestrop—
The name, because one afternoon
Of heat the express-train drew up there
Unwontedly. It was late June.

texts.title_ja: エリオット「東方の博士の旅」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
'A cold coming we had of it,
Just the worst time of the year
For a journey, and such a long journey'

texts.title_ja: エリオット『四つの四重奏曲』Burnt Norton冒頭
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Time present and time past
Are both perhaps present in time future,
And time future contained in time past.
If all time is eternally present

texts.title_ja: パウンド『カセイ』「商人の妻の手紙」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
While my hair was still cut straight across my forehead
I played about the front gate, pulling flowers.
You came by on bamboo stilts, playing horse,
You walked about my seat, playing with blue plums.

texts.title_ja: パウンド『マウバリー』
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
For three years, out of key with his time,
He strove to resuscitate the dead art
Of poetry; to maintain 'the sublime'
In the old sense

texts.title_ja: スティーヴンス「日曜の朝」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Complacencies of the peignoir, and late
Coffee and oranges in a sunny chair,
And the green freedom of a cockatoo
Upon a rug mingle to dissipate

texts.title_ja: スティーヴンス「アイスクリームの皇帝」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Call the roller of big cigars,
The muscular one, and bid him whip
In kitchen cups concupiscent curds.

texts.title_ja: スティーヴンス「雪の男」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
One must have a mind of winter
To regard the frost and the boughs
Of the pine-trees crusted with snow

texts.title_ja: ウィリアムズ『パタソン』第1巻
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Paterson lies in the valley under the Passaic Falls
its spent waters forming the outline of his back

texts.title_ja: フロスト「白樺」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
When I see birches bend to left and right
Across the lines of straighter darker trees,
I like to think some boy's been swinging them.

texts.title_ja: フロスト「壁を修繕する」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Something there is that doesn't love a wall,
That sends the frozen-ground-swell under it,
And spills the upper boulders in the sun;
And makes gaps even two can pass abreast.

texts.title_original: Dickinson, I heard a Fly buzz
texts.title_ja: ディキンソン「死ぬ時に蠅が」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
I heard a Fly buzz - when I died -
The Stillness in the Room
Was like the Stillness in the Air -
Between the Heaves of Storm

texts.title_ja: ディキンソン「荒れ狂う夜」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Wild nights – Wild nights!
Were I with thee
Wild nights should be
Our luxury!

texts.title_original: Dickinson, I'm Nobody! Who are you?
texts.title_ja: ディキンソン「私は誰でもない！あなたは誰？」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
I'm Nobody! Who are you?
Are you – Nobody – too?
Then there's a pair of us!
Don't tell! they'd advertise – you know!

texts.title_ja: ボードレール「旅」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Pour l'enfant, amoureux de cartes et d'estampes,
L'univers est égal à son vaste appétit.
Ah! que le monde est grand à la clarté des lampes!
Aux yeux du souvenir que le monde est petit!

texts.title_ja: ボードレール「敵」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Ma jeunesse ne fut qu'un ténébreux orage,
Traversé çà et là par de brillants soleils;
Le tonnerre et la pluie ont fait un tel ravage,
Qu'il reste en mon jardin bien peu de fruits vermeils.

texts.title_ja: ランボー「感覚」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Par les soirs bleus d'été, j'irai dans les sentiers,
Picoté par les blés, fouler l'herbe menue:
Rêveur, j'en sentirai la fraîcheur à mes pieds.
Je laisserai le vent baigner ma tête nue.

texts.title_ja: ランボー『イルミナシオン』「曙」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt: J'ai embrassé l'aube d'été. Rien ne bougeait encore au front des palais.

texts.title_ja: ランボー「永遠」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Elle est retrouvée.
Quoi? – L'Éternité.
C'est la mer allée
Avec le soleil.

texts.title_ja: ヴェルレーヌ「月の光」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Votre âme est un paysage choisi
Que vont charmant masques et bergamasques,
Jouant du luth et dansant et quasi
Tristes sous leurs déguisements fantasques.

texts.title_ja: アポリネール「ゾーン」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
À la fin tu es las de ce monde ancien
Bergère ô tour Eiffel le troupeau des ponts bêle ce matin
Tu en as assez de vivre dans l'antiquité grecque et romaine
Ici même les automobiles ont l'air d'être anciennes

texts.title_ja: ヴァレリー『若きパルク』
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Qui pleure là, sinon le vent simple, à cette heure
Seule, avec diamants extrêmes ?... Mais qui pleure,
Si proche de moi-même au moment de pleurer ?

texts.title_ja: ヴァレリー「海辺の墓地」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Ce toit tranquille, où marchent des colombes,
Entre les pins palpite, entre les tombes;
Midi le juste y compose de feux
La mer, la mer, toujours recommencée!

texts.title_ja: リルケ「古代アポロン胴体」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Wir kannten nicht sein unerhörtes Haupt,
darin die Augenäpfel reiften. Aber
sein Torso glüht noch wie ein Kandelaber,
in dem sein Schauen, nur zurückgeschraubt

texts.title_ja: リルケ『オルフェウスへのソネット』第1部第1番
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Da stieg ein Baum. O reine Übersteigung!
O Orpheus singt! O hoher Baum im Ohr!
Und alles schwieg. Doch selbst in der Verschweigung
ging neuer Anfang, Wink und Wandlung vor.

texts.title_ja: トラークル「夢の中のセバスチャン」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Mutter trug das Kindlein im weißen Mond,
Im Schatten des Nußbaums, uralten Holunders

texts.title_ja: シュテファン・ゲオルゲ『第七の輪』
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Komm in den totgesagten park und schau:
Der schimmer ferner lächelnder gestade,
Der reinen wolken unverhofftes blau

texts.title_original: Lorca, Llanto por Ignacio Sánchez Mejías
texts.title_ja: ロルカ「闘牛士イグナシオ・サンチェス・メヒーアスへの哀歌」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
A las cinco de la tarde.
Eran las cinco en punto de la tarde.
Un niño trajo la blanca sábana
a las cinco de la tarde.

texts.title_ja: ペソア（カエイロ）『羊の群を守る者』
texts.era_period: ポルトガル・モダニズム
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Eu nunca guardei rebanhos,
Mas é como se os guardasse.
Minha alma é como um pastor,
Conhece o vento e o sol

texts.title_ja: モンターレ「気だるく蒼ざめた午後」
texts.era_period: イタリア・モダニズム
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Meriggiare pallido e assorto
presso un rovente muro d'orto,
ascoltare tra i pruni e gli sterpi
schiocchi di merli, frusci di serpi.

texts.title_ja: ウンガレッティ「朝」
texts.era_period: イタリア・モダニズム
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
M'illumino
d'immenso

texts.title_ja: ウンガレッティ「兵士たち」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Si sta come
d'autunno
sugli alberi
le foglie

texts.title_ja: アントニオ・マチャード「画廊」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
He andado muchos caminos,
he abierto muchas veredas;
he navegado en cien mares,
y atracado en cien riberas

texts.title_ja: ヒメネス「樹々の人々」
texts.era_period: スペイン・モダニズム
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Yo me embarcaré una tarde
con el viento de mi sueño,
en el lirio de mi mar

texts.title_ja: プーシキン「素晴らしき一瞬を覚えている」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Я помню чудное мгновенье:
Передо мной явилась ты,
Как мимолетное виденье,
Как гений чистой красоты.

texts.title_ja: プーシキン「預言者」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Духовной жаждою томим,
В пустыне мрачной я влачился,
И шестикрылый серафим
На перепутье мне явился

texts.title_ja: プーシキン『エヴゲーニー・オネーギン』第1章第2連
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Так думал молодой повеса,
Летя в пыли на почтовых,
Всевышней волею Зевеса
Наследник всех своих родных

texts.title_ja: ブローク『十二』
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Чёрный вечер.
Белый снег.
Ветер, ветер!

texts.title_ja: ブローク「見知らぬ女」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
По вечерам над ресторанами
Горячий воздух дик и глух,
И правит окриками пьяными
Весенний и тлетворный дух

texts.title_ja: マヤコフスキー「聴いてくれ！」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Послушайте!
Ведь, если звезды зажигают —
значит — это кому-нибудь нужно?
Значит — это необходимо

texts.title_ja: エセーニン「母への手紙」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Ты жива еще, моя старушка?
Жив и я. Привет тебе, привет!
Пусть струится над твоей избушкой
Тот вечерний несказанный свет

texts.title_ja: アフマートワ「なぜ水を毒したのか」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Зачем вы отравили воду
И с грязью мой смешали хлеб?

texts.title_ja: ツヴェターエワ「私の詩に」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Моим стихам, написанным так рано,
Что и не знала я, что я — поэт,
Сорвавшимся, как брызги из фонтана,
Как искры из ракет

texts.title_ja: パステルナーク「冬の夜」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Мело, мело по всей земле
Во все пределы.
Свеча горела на столе,
Свеча горела

texts.title_ja: レールモントフ「ボロジノ」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
– Скажи-ка, дядя, ведь не даром
Москва, спалённая пожаром,
Французу отдана?
Ведь были ж схватки боевые

texts.title_ja: レールモントフ『悪魔』
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Печальный Демон, дух изгнанья,
Летал над грешною землёй,
И лучших дней воспоминанья

texts.title_ja: ミツキェヴィチ『パン・タデウシュ』冒頭
texts.era_period: ポーランド・ロマン派
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Litwo! Ojczyzno moja! ty jesteś jak zdrowie;
Ile cię trzeba cenić, ten tylko się dowie,
Kto cię stracił. Dziś piękność twą w całej ozdobie
Widzę i opisuję, bo tęsknię po tobie.

texts.title_ja: ペテーフィ「自由よ、愛よ」
texts.era_period: ハンガリー・ロマン派
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Szabadság, szerelem!
E kettő kell nekem.
Szerelmemért föláldozom
Az életet

texts.title_ja: レオパルディ「無限」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Sempre caro mi fu quest'ermo colle,
e questa siepe, che da tanta parte
dell'ultimo orizzonte il guardo esclude.
Ma sedendo e mirando, interminati

texts.title_ja: レオパルディ「シルヴィアに」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Silvia, rimembri ancora
Quel tempo della tua vita mortale,
Quando beltà splendea
Negli occhi tuoi ridenti e fuggitivi

texts.title_ja: カルドゥッチ「いにしえの嘆き」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
L'albero a cui tendevi
La pargoletta mano,
Il verde melograno
Da' bei vermigli fior

texts.title_ja: ダンヌンツィオ「松林の雨」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Taci. Su le soglie
del bosco non odo
parole che dici
umane; ma odo

texts.title_ja: パスコリ「洗濯女たち」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Nel campo mezzo grigio e mezzo nero
resta un aratro senza buoi, che pare
dimenticato, tra il vapor leggero.
E cadenzato dalla gora viene

texts.title_ja: ペソア「ポルトガルの海」（『メンサジェン』）
texts.era_period: ポルトガル・モダニズム
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Ó mar salgado, quanto do teu sal
São lágrimas de Portugal!
Por te cruzarmos, quantas mães choraram,
Quantos filhos em vão rezaram!

texts.title_ja: カモンイス「優しき魂よ」
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
Alma minha gentil, que te partiste
tão cedo desta vida, descontente,
repousa lá no Céu eternamente,
e viva eu cá na terra sempre triste

texts.title_ja: カモンイス『ウズ・ルジアダス』第1歌冒頭
texts.full_text_or_excerpt:
As armas e os barões assinalados,
Que da Ocidental praia Lusitana,
Por mares nunca de antes navegados,
Passaram ainda além da Taprobana
